name: total-recall
description: Cross-session, cross-CLI memory for Claude Code and other AI coding assistants. Mines the operator's transcripts from Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Continue, Cline, Aider. Surfaces identity / decisions / bans / corrections via 23 MCP tools + 5 hooks + 15 slash commands + 2 skills. The operator becomes the source of truth; the model stops re-asking what they already told it.
